top_verse_en: Brothers, children of Abraham, and you Gentiles who fear God, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.

refs.t_en: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue leaders sent word to them: "Brothers, if you have a word of encouragement for the people, please speak." . . .
When God raised up His servant, He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways."
O our God, did You not drive out the inhabitants of this land before Your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham Your friend?
O offspring of Abraham His servant, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel. . . .
But you, O Israel, My servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, descendant of Abraham My friend--

Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, who have descended from the line of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD and invoke the God of Israel--but not in truth or righteousness--
Listen to Me, you who pursue righteousness, you who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut, and to the quarry from which you were hewn. . . .
And do not presume to say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father.' For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.
and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
Paul stood up, motioned with his hand, and began to speak: "Men of Israel and you Gentiles who fear God, listen to me! . . .
but welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.
This girl followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, "These men are servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation."
Be advised, therefore, that God's salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!"
I am bringing My righteousness near; it is not far away, and My salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion, My splendor to Israel.
He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David, . . .
I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, first to the Jew, then to the Greek.

outline.text_en: Paul and Barnabas are chosen to go to the Gentiles.
Of Sergius Paulus, and Elymas the sorcerer.
Paul preaches at Antioch that Jesus is Christ.
but the Jews talked abusively against Paul,
whereupon they turn to the Gentiles, of whom many believe.
The Jews raise a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, who go to Iconium.

parallel_en.text: "Brethren, sons of Abraham's family, and those among you who fear God, to us the message of this salvation has been sent.
Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
Brothers, sons of Abraham's race, and those among you who fear God, the message of this salvation has been sent to us.
"My brothers, descendants of Abraham's family, and those among you who fear God, it is to us that the message of this salvation has been sent.
Brothers, descendants of Abraham's family, and those Gentiles among you who fear God, the message of this salvation has been sent to us.
Men, brothers and children of the lineage of Abraham, and those who worship God with you: To you He has been sent: The Word of Life.
